name: the HTML name attribute is never a name
a button is named by its text
a select is not named by its option list
text over 80 characters is a paragraph, not a name

fingerprint.inner_text: A very long run of visible words that goes on and on well past what any accessible name would be

name: a form control is named by its label
a link is not named by a neighbouring label
a keyboard-shortcut hint is not part of the name
a label-less input is named by its placeholder
